scope: Fixed linear thermal theta integration through persistent CUDA history and PCG/AMG
setup: Host M/K/effective CSR assembly and symmetric AMG setup. Caller provides reduced free-DOF matrices, initial temperature and explicit SPD assumption.
resident_steps: Mass and stiffness actions, theta source combination, PCG, true-residual certification and committed temperature history use CUDA. Source vectors remain caller-owned on the same stream.

validation.source_weighting: T=2+t with M=2, K=3, f(t)=8+3t: five steps each for theta 0, 0.5, 0.75, 1; error <1e-10
validation.failure_contract: Invalid dt/theta/CSR; wrong-length and foreign-stream sources reject before dispatch; NaN, injected launch/D2D failures and nonconvergence preserve committed temperature and step count; valid retry succeeds

limitations: Fixed linear M/K, dt, theta and constraint layout; reprepare for changes
No nonlinear/advection admission implied by PCG; caller must certify effective SPD operator
Pure-Neumann/DAE and boundary lifting are caller-owned; physical tests use homogeneous Dirichlet reduction
Explicit theta stability is not inferred from linear residual
Initial/assembly/source uploads and requested output downloads remain explicit
Compact validation and convergence reductions reach host
Sparse/preconditioner allocations retain partial pool-quota coverage
No end-to-end speedup claim; continuum discretization error is distinct from CPU/GPU parity
